profile.summary:
GITHUB …
https://github.com/greenhouse

PROFESSIONAL ABSTRACT ...
Formally educated software engineer with over 10 years of real-world development experience spanning the full spectrum of modern technology. With deep expertise in mobile application development, server-side infrastructure, database design, VOIP services, network security, blockchain/cryptocurrency technologies, and AI inferencing & fine-tuning.

10+ years of software engineering & system architecture work experience
   o  Client-side stack: ObjC, C++, Lua, Swift, html, JavaScript
   o  Server-side stack: Python, Lua, PSQL, MySQL, C#, Java, Solidity

Well versed in the Software Development Life Cycle, from conception and validation, through system design/integration and execution.

Extremely passionate about working with algorithmic & system design

Extremely motivated towards working with new and advancing technologies such as distributed systems, telecommunication, the IP networking infrastructure, and pen-testing / network security.

ABOUT ME ...
Strong belief in “the world that we are building holds more value than the world we have built.”

Continuous education is the most important model in my life.  I strive to place myself within the bounds of new challenges and personal training, on a daily basis.  I have come to understand how this feeds motivation in passing on what we have learned to others.  And I strongly believe that passing on what we have learned to others, is the only way we can succeed in building a world we can value.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
BridgeGap Inc. develops software applications specializing in native code base integration. Providing custom built code base, algorithmic, and protocol design patterns

Full-Stack System Architecture:
   •  Client side: Objective C, C++, Swift, Java (w/ HTML, CSS & JS home page or CMS layouts)
   •  Server side: linux/ubunut, Python (flask/django), C#.Net, SQL, AWS (EC2, S3, Route53
   •  AI: data preprocessing, fine-tuning pre-trained models, RAG based inferencing

PROJECTS:
o AI85 (SaaS): Platform providing private AI Agents for niche industries 
   • AI Web Helper - Pick a website, and our AI scrapes the data you need (useful for complex .gov sites)
   • AI Personal Assistant - connect your email, and ask AI about anything in your life
   • Business Intelligence AI - Sync your database for insights that drive your industry forward
   • https://ai85solutions.com

o Pink (iOS/Android + BE): Recruiting based service where hosts cast guests for scheduled events
   •  https://www.pink.io (unreleased)

o  WineKey App (BE): Web app service dedicated towards helping sommeliers track, record, and better perform during blind wine tastings (https://www.winekeyapp.com)
   •  https://itunes.apple.com/app/id992700699
   •  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.winekeyapplication.Winekey

o  Muzik (iOS/Android + SDK design): Intelligent touch-sensor based headphones. Connect via BlueTooth and utilize SDK for programmable hot-keys and swipe gestures. 
   •  https://muzikconnect.com
   •  https://itunes.apple.com/app/id718384253 (iOS SDK demo application)

o  Kombie (iOS + BE): Audio/Video splicing based mobile application. Allows editing of music videos to combine with video selfies or additional customization. Video splicing and editing is performed client side. (https://angel.co/kombie | https://www.kombie.com)
   •  https://itunes.apple.com/app/id965119045 (app store removed)

positions.description:

Implementation:

positions.title: Founder / Developer
positions.description:
Founder / Developer
CoPark is an ‘Uber like’ service that allows Venice Beach patrons to park in private Venice Beach driveways. Raised $30k investment for Proof Of Concept and Beta Execution.

Feature integration:
   •  2 apps: One for renting your driveway and One for selecting a driveway to park in
   •  GPS map integration
   •  Direct merchant service payment pass-through (no overhead from PayPal, Braintree, etc.) 

Implementation:
   •  Objective C / C++ Client side integration with native network layer controller 
   •  Full native database and server side integration (NGINX, Python (Flask), PostgreSQL)
   •  CreditCard OCR integration (CardIO)

Web: https://www.copark.la
Download: https://appsto.re/us/XaXzdb.i
Download: https://appsto.re/us/XV8Bdb.i

positions.title: iOS / OS X Software Engineer
positions.description:
iOS / OS X client side app integration for streaming video feeds with pattern/human recognition
Project: WiZR is a video security monitoring system dedicated toward human detection.

Feature integration:
   •  Full iOS mobile code base MVC
   •  Apple WatchKit v1 video streaming hack (1 or 2 fps)

Implementation:
   •  Objective C / C++ Client side integration with native network layer controller (custom mp4 streaming)

positions.title: Lead Developer/CTO
positions.description:
Project Name: YetiChat (iOS appstore 'available')
Download: http://yeti.ai

Built interactive (‘Tinder’ like) card swipe messaging platform.
With Yeti Chat, you swipe through user created discussions. ‘Swipe Right’ to join a discussion, or ‘Swipe Left’ to pass.
Features:
 - Animated card swiping interface
 - Location based service for aggregating discussions near you
Implementation:
 - Objective C: UI / Client side
 - AFNetworking: communication wrapper
 - Python / NGINX server side: utilize Flask for url routing and database query
 - PSQL: database integration

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work with an awesome team of 5 for implementation and testing of a password, address, and financial management tool
- Objective C front-end developer, utilizing C++ for server side/cloud communication
- Working with both sync and async server calls for effective event/callback handling
- Efficiently utilize key value collections in conjunction with NSDictionarys (mostly corp. APIs, but I definitely grasp it)
- Extensive work with CATransaction & NSAnimationContext grouping for syncing animation within code (fun here!) 
- Utilize both xib files and manual coding for effectively maintaining UI components (can be tricky, need to be strategic)
- Utilize regular expressions for error checking (email addresses, password formats, etc.)
- Worked with OCMock objects for UnitTesting (still getting the hang of this)
- Adhere to efficient error checking, error handling, edge casing, etc. (always try to catch things before QA does)
- Maintaining effective communication and transparency between all platforms (other IDSafe teams)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of 8 for collaborative design, implementation, testing, release, bug support, and feature requests
Front End Web Development (html/css/javascript):
- JavaScript frameworks: jQuery and Ext for client-side scripting; StealJS for dependency management
- jQuery: Created html iframe widget for displaying MS word, powerpoint, and xml documents
- Utilized Ozone widget framework: focus on search query and data retrieval
- Utilized JSON for search querying
Back End Cloud Base Development (java):
- Java: Created .ppt/.pptx and .doc/.docx to html transformer (utilizing apache POI)
- Java: Worked with xslt’s for xml conversions
- Java: Learning to communicate through REST api with Apache Solr for server side search querying
- Debug crash dumps: review server side stack traces
Manage documentation: Knowledge Base articles / How-to guides

positions.title: Field Application Engineer
positions.description:
Development Support:
- Alter demo applications; troubleshoot customer code; 
- Review API traces; analyze windows event viewer logs
- Utilize CoolEdit for analyzing raw media: wave patterns, audio quality issues, bit rates
- Debug crash dumps / trace call stacks / utilize symbol files
- Debug API calls of writing to buffer / write to file / transcoding to and from RTP packets
- Work closely with R&D in developing algorithms for bug fixes and new features
- Working with regular expressions for quick fixes, workarounds, matching call flows/call types

Networking Support:
- Utilize Colasoft Packet Player for reproduction with network captures
- Utilize Ethereal/Wireshark for analyzing payload types, MTU issues, 
        analyze protocol bit patterns
- Analyze socket binding errors, disk I/O errors, IP routing issues, confirm packets mirroring
- Creating documentation / Knowledge Base articles / How-to guides
- Liaison between R&D and customer, relay customer concerns, gather R&D requirements
